title: Recursive comparison reads a record’s named component before its boolean alias
summary: Recursive comparison detected different record components sharing a boolean alias. A constant JavaBeans getter still caused different stored strings to compare equal.

change.description: When inspecting a record, AssertJ looks for an accessor with the component’s own name before trying an is-prefixed method.

notes: The landed source tries getField() before the bare accessor. Both objects return the same constant. The generated component accessor provides an independent reference.
